PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Persistent player progression, high score, coin wallet, kitty skins, power-up levels, and active mission progress for Gatinho Metrô.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

displayName.description: Display name shown in profile and scoreboard.

totalCoins.description: Available coins for unlocking kitty skins and upgrading power-ups.

scoreMultiplier.description: Current score multiplier unlocked via mission tiers.

unlockedSkins.description: List of unlocked kitty skin identifiers.

magnetLevel.description: Upgrade level (1-5) for the coin magnet duration.

jetpackLevel.description: Upgrade level (1-5) for the jetpack flying power-up duration.

missionCoinsWithMagnet.description: Cumulative coins collected while magnet is active in current mission tier.

missionJetpackFlights.description: Cumulative jetpack flights activated in current mission tier.

missionTotalMeters.description: Cumulative meters run in current mission tier.

missionTrainsPassed.description: Cumulative trains dodged or surfed in current mission tier.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of profile creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

RunRecord.title: RunRecord
RunRecord.description: Immutable record of an individual subway run with score, coins, distance, magnet coins, and jetpack flight distance.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

magnetCoins.description: Coins pulled using the magnet power-up in this run.

jetpackMeters.description: Meters flown using the jetpack power-up in this run.

skinId.description: Kitty skin used during the run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of run completion (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Player profile, wallet, power-up upgrades, kitty skins, and mission progress.

/users/{userId}/runs/{runId}.description: Per-user history of completed subway runs.
